Nelson: Quick FYI — canary (bk-3) showed p95 decode jump from 120ms -> 310ms after yesterday's kernel flip.
Marie: Any smoke logs? KV hitrate?
Nelson: KV hitrate on that host dropped 86% -> 62% under mixed prompt lengths. Attached profiler snippet.
Alex: ugh. Did we fallback to generic kernel or the fp16-quant path?
Nelson: kernel selection picked generic_fp32 for long-running decodes; because cohort classifier sent those requests to 'decode>70' bin which prefers stability, but those had short prompts too.
Vikram: So classifier is conflating decode rate and prompt length. We need microcohorts.
Sam: Proposed microcohort key: <plen_bucket, decode_bucket, kv_affinity>. Start with buckets: plen: [<=64,65-256,>256], decode: [<=40,41-80,>80].
Marie: Agree. Also token_budget_target tweak: high-decode (>80) -> 24 tokens, mid 32, low 48. Cuts tail latency.
Nelson: Ran a 1h canary with those targets: p95 reduced 310ms -> 190ms, KV hitrate stable +3%, throughput +6% (sampled).
Alex: share config snippet?
Nelson: ```json
{"admission": {"microcohort_strategy": "combined", "plen_buckets": [64,256], "decode_buckets": [40,80], "token_budget_targets": {"high": 24, "mid": 32, "low": 48}}}
```
Vikram: Nice. Also added kernel hint: if plen<=64 && decode>80 prefer kernel=fast_stream_fp16. That avoids generic_fp32 fallback.
Sam: Any regressions observed elsewhere?
Nelson: On long prompt heavy workload p95 unchanged, small p50 improvement. No perf regression on dedicated pools.
Marie: Let's roll to 10% fleet for tonight, watch KV eviction logs and kernel-switch counters. @Ops-bot schedule canary at 02:00 UTC :rocket:
Ops-bot: scheduled canary on eng-runtime-canal at 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z :white_check_mark:
Alex: I'll add tracing tags for microcohort and kernel_hint so we can query in datadog.
Marie: Also add a regression alert if p95 increases >15% in 5m, and KV hitrate drops >7%.
Nelson: I'll push PR with config and microcohort classifier tests. PTAL: https://git.redwood/ri/inference-runtime/pulls/432
Sam: TY. If canary looks good, we'll promote and update rollout policies.
Marie: Thanks all :thumbsup:
